decisions.reason: The closed baseline shows all six incident labels and c’s exact unavailable reason, plus title, subtitle, notice, summary, primary label and entire footer. Collapsed guidance and incident dossiers are intentionally excluded. All required text is present and not ellipsized, but the f label breaks pressure-gauge as “pressure-gau / ge drift”. The approved brief requires natural breaks at spaces and hyphens before character fallback for an overwide segment. This fails the natural-wrapping proposition; this is not an overlap or missing-text finding. The complete coherent sweep was inspected.
